title: CredibilityParams
description: Credibility spiral parameters. SPEC-CRED-4: anchor threshold, drift, and recovery knobs.

anchor_threshold.description: Credibility level at or above which expectations remain anchored.

consecutive_months.description: Ticks below anchor_threshold required before the spiral activates.

drift_per_period.description: Per-month widening of the expectations gap once the spiral is active.

recovery_rate.description: Per-month recovery of expectations_anchor toward target_inflation. Must be > 0 — a zero rate would silently disable spiral recovery (recovery_rate * stanceMultiplier always 0).

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target that expectations_anchor converges to on recovery.
